sentences.en: My boy, this peace is what true warriors strive for.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子，真正的武士追求的就是和平。

sentences.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
sentences.zh: 武士清楚地认识到自己的力量和弱点。

sentences.en: The chief massed his warriors to attack the fort.
sentences.zh: 酋长集结了他的战士去攻打堡垒。

senses.zh: 战士，勇士；鼓吹战争的人Warrior猎户星座
